text:
sam: Noticed a burst of 503s hitting eu-west1 embeddings since ~22:00 UTC. I built a tiny restartless hotfix (hotfix/evict-patch-1.2.5) that should stop the KV eviction race. Can we fast-track a short window at 22:15-22:30 UTC?

deploy-bot: /deploy request opened: repo=rl-inference ref=hotfix/evict-patch-1.2.5 env=eu-west1 strategy=restartless-canary id=DBOT-10100

lia: Ops wants runbook and rollback commands before signoff. Please include exact canary gates.

sre-oncall: Risk: code change minimal. Operational note: prefix cache may be cold and bump p99. Rollback plan: pin to v1.2.3 and run forced clear. Gates: error-rate > 2% sustained 5m OR p99 > 900ms sustained 5m triggers rollback.

jin: Canary suggestion: 1% for 10m -> 8% for 8m -> 100%. Auto-fallback on triggers.

release-manager: Prepared changelog draft; will publish after successful rollout.

sam: Runbook posted: https://runbooks/evict-1.2.5. Rollback command: `kubectl run kvclear --image=ops/kvclear:stable --env=eu-west1`. Metrics: https://dash/embeddings?env=eu-west1

lia: Runbook validated, PD hooks set. Ops ready to pin on command.

platform-ops: Standing by for traffic pin/reroute.

deploy-bot: T-minus 3m to scheduled start. Any objections?
sam: none, proceed.
deploy-bot: STARTED DBOT-10100  rolling 1% canary.
deploy-bot: CANARY CHECK (5m): errors 0.5% baseline 0.1%, p99 +110ms. Gates OK.
sre-oncall: No new errors in traces. continuing to monitor.
deploy-bot: PROMOTED to 8% after canary.
deploy-bot: 8% running 8:20Z observing 8m.
jin: metrics stable, no customer reports.
sre-oncall: p99 settling; errors ~0.7%. safe to finish.
deploy-bot: ROLLOUT COMPLETE: v1.2.5 at 100% in eu-west1. Audit: https://deploys/dbot/10100/audit

release-manager: Changelog published; support notified. Tag v1.2.5.
sam: Thanks team, closing thread.

lia: nice fast turnaround. :thumbsup:
